pages.text: Monsters at the door? A $(l)Laser Turret$() keeps them out. Give it power and it turns its head toward the nearest hostile mob it can see and burns it down.

Place it where it can see the ground you want to guard. It watches $(l)16 blocks$() all round: a sphere 33 blocks across, as wide as the largest drone work area.$(br2)Power it with an $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l) or any other mod's cable, from any side.
pages.title: Placing and powering

pages.text: $(l)Right-click$() it to see what it is doing. The red lens on the barrel lights up while it aims.

$(li)$(l)Range$(): 16 blocks all round$(br)$(li)$(l)Damage$(): 8 a shot (a zombie lasts three shots)$(br)$(li)$(l)Fire rate$(): one shot a second$(br)$(li)$(l)Energy per shot$(): 200 FE (25 FE per point of damage)$(br)$(li)$(l)Power use$(): 10 FE/t while it fights, none while nothing is in sight
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Energy buffer$(): 20,000 FE$(br)One $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l) keeps six turrets firing. The $(l:drone_systems/modules)Guard Module$(/l)'s laser, fired in flight, costs twice as much per point of damage.

It shoots $(l)hostile mobs only$(). These are safe:$(br)$(li)players, animals, villagers and golems;$(br)$(li)$(l)named mobs$(): your mob farms are safe if you name the mobs you keep;$(br)$(li)mobs $(l)riding$() something (a minecart, a boat);
pages.title: What it shoots

pages.text: $(li)$(l)neutral mobs$() (endermen, zombified piglins) until they get angry.$(br)It needs a clear view: no block between its head and the mob's eyes. Glass stops it too.

A turret stays where you put it. For an area that moves with your farm, give a drone a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Guard Module$(/l): it flies over its work area and shoots the same mobs from above. For a big wave, a swarm of Mini Drones with the $(l:drone_systems/modules)Bomb Module$(/l) dives at the monsters and blows up on them.
